seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Fenton, Michigan for 2026: 3 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Fenton and neighboring Linden pack parades, fireworks and Santa into one December weekend, and Spicer Orchards runs a Christmas train.
celebrates: Fenton's Jinglefest on Saturday, December 5, 2026, runs from Breakfast with Santa at 9 am to a 6 pm lighted parade, community tree lighting and fireworks, according to the Fenton and Linden Regional Chamber of Commerce. The night before, Linden's Holiday Happening has an Elf Hunt, a Frosty Parade, fireworks over the Millpond and trackless train rides. Spicer Orchards in Fenton runs its Christmas Train to Santa from the day after Thanksgiving through December 23.
lastyear: The 2025 Jinglefest was held on Saturday, December 6, 2025, with breakfast and shopping at 9 am, Rotary tree decorating at Bush Park at 10 am, activities at 3 pm and the parade at 6 pm, followed by the tree lighting, fireworks and Cookies with Santa, according to a local recap of the City of Fenton schedule. Linden's 2025 Holiday Happening was Friday, December 5, 2025.
facts: Jinglefest 2026 lists Letters to Santa from the FHS Key Club and Kiwanis Club, photos with Santa from the Kiwanis Club of Fenton and fireworks from Fenton Festivals Inc. Breakfast with Santa is at the Fenton Community and Cultural Center, 150 S. Leroy Street, per a local recap. Spicer Orchards' Santa visit includes a bonfire and the Mistletoe Trail.
trains: Fenton has real Christmas train options. Spicer Orchards' Spicer Express carries families through the orchard to Santa's Sleigh Cabin or Santa's Gingerbread Barn from the day after Thanksgiving through December 23, by reservation. Linden's Holiday Happening adds trackless train rides after the parade on December 4. Farther away, the Southern Michigan Railroad runs its Santa Express in Clinton, Michigan, on select weekends from November 28 to December 13, 2026.

The magic runs from November 27 (Christmas Train to Santa at Spicer Orchards, through December 23) with the Linden Holiday Happening (December 4) and Jinglefest (December 5) along the way. Linden is folded into this page. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
